l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.r.a: Iwela izikhathi ezi-2, ngakho ayifezi umbandela wokungu-1 ubukhulu.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.r.c: Iwela izikhathi ezingu-3, ngakho ayifezi umbandela.
l-m-e1-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Izindlela ezinokuwela okungu-1 ubukhulu ziyiNdlela 2 neNdlela 4, futhi emfushane kuzo, iNdlela 2, iyafaneleka.
